about: Written by web-vectors.test.ts from the app's own functions. hex = lower case hex, b64 = Base64url without padding. See the comment at the top of that file for the layout.

cases.name: switch-in-a-settings-row
cases.note: one bool field of a section: field stamp and row stamp (plan 2.3 rule 3)

cases.name: several-categories-one-save
cases.note: bool, number, text and list fields in four rows (three sections, one appearance row), one common time

cases.name: shared-preference-field
cases.note: a field of a split preference (FIELD_PREFERENCES) changes, a new field appears; only the field parts are stamped

cases.name: plain-preference
cases.note: a preference that is no split one is replaced as a whole text

cases.name: preference-and-field-removed
cases.note: a whole preference and a field of a split preference are removed: tombstones, no change stamp

cases.name: recreate-removed-preference
cases.note: a preference a device removed earlier (tombstone in stamps.deleted) is set again: the tombstone goes, the time is above it

cases.name: replace-a-secret
cases.note: the debrid key is replaced (the website never shows a secret, it only replaces it)

cases.name: whole-row-torrent-kept
cases.note: a whole row (torrentKept): columns replaced, changedAt and stamp set to the new time

cases.name: whole-row-offline-settings
cases.note: download only on Wi-Fi: a one-column row

cases.name: clock-behind-the-stamps
cases.note: the browser clock is before the last stamp of the field (T1): the new time is stamp + 1 (plan 2.3 rule 2)
